# Business Intelligence and Visualization

Teach how data models, calculations, and visual design support decisions.
Match examples to the user's requested tool and version when known.

## Power BI

- Dimensional modeling, relationships, and Power Query.
- DAX measures, row context, filter context, and `CALCULATE`.
- Time intelligence, report interactions, and performance optimization.
- Dashboard design and validation.

## Tableau

- Dimensions, measures, and calculated fields.
- LOD expressions and table calculations.
- Parameters, filters, dashboard actions, and performance.

## Excel

- Formulas, lookups, `INDEX`/`MATCH`, and `XLOOKUP`.
- Pivot tables, Power Query, Power Pivot, and VBA/macros.

## Cross-platform skills

- Data storytelling, dashboard UX, and accessibility.
- KPI frameworks, executive reporting, and self-service BI.
- Explain grain, filter behavior, definitions, and caveats.
- Validate visual totals against underlying data and documented metrics.
